wordmark.purpose: The 'ScoreUp' logotype only. Frank Ruhl Libre's only surviving use after it read heavy/blocky at Hebrew heading sizes on the shipped practice and dashboard screens.

heading-section.purpose: Section headings and card titles ('בניה עצמית', 'בניית תרגול מותאם אישית'). Heebo, extrabold.

body.purpose: All reading content: questions, answers, explanations, marketing copy.

numeral.purpose: Timer and question counter — tabular figures so digits never shift width.

shadows.name: card-ambient
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system: outer card shells, neutral warm-black, low opacity. Never colored/glowing.

motion.name: ease-reveal
motion.purpose: Answer-feedback and disclosure reveals (solution panel, correct/incorrect state), 250-350ms — precise and settled, never bouncy.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default forward action — next question, continue, submit.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1F4C4E; color: #fff; padding: 16px 24px; border-radius: 10px; border: none; font-weight: 500; font-family: Heebo, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #153536; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.99); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1F4C4E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: CTA Button
components.description: The single highest-intent action on a screen — start practicing, upgrade. Never paired with a competing Primary button on the same screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-cta { background: #DD6B42; color: #fff; padding: 16px 24px; border-radius: 10px; border: none; font-weight: 500; font-family: Heebo, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-cta:hover { background: #A64E2E; } .ds-btn-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #DD6B42; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Answer Option — Correct
components.description: Revealed-correct answer state in the practice screen.
components.css: .ds-option { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border: 1.5px solid #E4DED2; background: #fff; border-radius: 8px; padding: 13px 16px; font-family: Heebo, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: #1D2624; } .ds-option-correct { border-color: #2F7A5C; background: #E4F0EA; } .ds-option-letter { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 999px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-option-correct .ds-option-letter { background: #2F7A5C; color: #fff; border: none; }

components.name: Answer Option — Incorrect
components.description: Revealed-incorrect selected answer state in the practice screen.
components.css: .ds-option { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border: 1.5px solid #E4DED2; background: #fff; border-radius: 8px; padding: 13px 16px; font-family: Heebo, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: #1D2624; } .ds-option-wrong { border-color: #BE4A39; background: #FBEAE6; } .ds-option-letter { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 999px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-option-wrong .ds-option-letter { background: #BE4A39; color: #fff; border: none; }

components.name: Topic Badge
components.description: Quiet informational tag — topic name on a practice question.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #E4EDEC; color: #1F4C4E; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; font-family: Heebo, sans-serif; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 999px; }

components.name: Timer
components.description: Countdown / elapsed-time display. Tabular numerals are mandatory — digits must not shift width as the value changes.
components.css: .ds-timer { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #E4EDEC; color: #1F4C4E; font-family: Heebo, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: 0.02em; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 999px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Primary content shell (practice card, summary card, pricing card).
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #E4DED2; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(29,38,36,0.04), 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(29,38,36,0.12); padding: 24px; font-family: Heebo, sans-serif; color: #1D2624; }

narrative.overview: ScoreUp helps a stressed, time-pressured test-taker feel like they have command of the material in front of them. The system sits deliberately between two failure modes: it must never read as a dry, cold textbook (adds to exam anxiety) and never as a playful, gamified consumer app (undermines the seriousness of a real admissions exam). The rendition is a warm-neutral, structured, quietly confident interface — closer to a well-run instrument panel than to either a study manual or a language-learning app. This replaces an incumbent "Dark & Neon Tech" identity (near-black background, neon-cyan primary, glowing gradient blobs) that read as generic AI-startup chrome disconnected from the subject. The new system is light-first, warm-neutral, and reserves color for moments that matter — a functional discipline, not a decorative one: color marks the interactive edge (a button, a correct answer, a streak), never the ambient surface.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, light-first ground (never the near-black + neon accent AI-startup default)
One deep, desaturated primary (petrol) carries structure; a warm coral accent is rationed to CTA and success moments only
Frank Ruhl Libre marks the wordmark only; every heading is Heebo, differentiated by weight and size
Tabular numerals for the timer and question counter — exact, instrument-grade
Calmer corner radius than the incumbent system — structured and serious, not bubbly

rules.name: The Rationed Accent Rule
rules.body: Coral appears only on a primary call-to-action or a success/achievement moment — never as a structural or decorative color. If more than one element on a screen is coral, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every gray in this system (background, borders, muted text) carries a warm/beige bias. A cool or blue-gray value anywhere in the UI is a regression to the old identity, not a stylistic variant.

rules.name: The Wordmark-Only Rule
rules.body: Frank Ruhl Libre renders the ScoreUp logotype and nothing else. Every heading at every level is Heebo — hierarchy comes from weight and size, never a typeface switch. Shipped as headline face across the practice/dashboard screens first, then pulled back to wordmark-only once it read heavy and blocky against Heebo body text at Hebrew heading sizes.

rules.name: The Reading Content Rule
rules.body: Question text, answer options, and explanations are always Heebo at body weight.

rules.name: The Tabular Numeral Rule
rules.body: Any digit sequence the user tracks in real time (countdown timer, question X of Y) uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The No-Glow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are neutral warm-black at low opacity. A colored/saturated shadow (the incumbent cyan/blue glow) is a regression to the old identity, not a legitimate elevation variant.

dos: Do keep Heebo as the body/reading face everywhere text is meant to be read at length
Do use tabular numerals for the timer and question counter
Do treat RTL as a hard functional constraint: logical properties, mirrored directional icons, no hardcoded left/right
Do keep Coral to a single use per screen
donts: Don't reintroduce a saturated glow shadow, gradient blob, or neon-cyan accent anywhere
Don't use Frank Ruhl Libre (or any serif) anywhere but the wordmark — not headings, not body text
Don't use a cool/blue-gray for any neutral
Don't invent a second accent color
